rationale: I read the held original of EO 7814 (FR Doc. 38-508, February 15, 1938, closing line [No. 7814]) in full and confirmed identity: it revokes EO 4430 of April 23, 1926, as modified, only as to lot 1, sec. 9, T. 32 N., R. 9 W., Fourth Principal Meridian (0.50 acre), a self-executing one-time command performed on signing, whose released lot is a surviving consequence, not a continuing command. The held official text of EO 8861 (August 20, 1941) revokes EO 4430 as a whole, so no parent withdrawal remains to be modified; it does not name EO 7814 and is correctly not treated as EO 7814's ending, which is exhaustion by performance on 1938-02-15. A cruden search found no other held text naming EO 7814, so status no is supported through 2026-10-14. Every evidence record's held text was re-hashed against its recorded text_sha256 and every recorded span was compared with the held file (all matched); the producer's two history observations were checked against the held texts and no history flags require resolution.
